title: IMDbPro Contact Scraper
description: Scrape people from an IMDbPro discovery URL and extract available Direct Contact information using the IMDbPro authentication state supplied for this run.

startUrl.title: IMDbPro Discovery URL
startUrl.description: Paste the exact IMDbPro discovery/search URL you want to scrape.

authState.title: IMDbPro Authentication State
authState.description: Paste the complete Playwright storage-state JSON for the IMDbPro account/session you want to use. This should normally contain cookies and origins.

maxPages.title: Maximum Discovery Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of discovery pages to process. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum Profiles
maxProfiles.description: Maximum number of people/profiles to process. Use 0 for unlimited.
